            ************************************
            *    c|net: the Computer Network   *
            *                                  *
            *  THE NEXT STEP IN INTERACTIVITY  *
            ************************************
 
            Programming/System Design Positions
                       (Central NJ)
 
 
c|net (the Computer Network) is a startup company producing
multimedia content to serve the needs of the 60 million
computer & video game users.  (Paul Allen has a significant
investment in the company.)
 
c|net will distribute information using both cable television
(c|net TV) & an online service (c|net Online).  c|net TV is
led by an industry award-winning production staff.  The first
show (c|net central) will launch on April 1, 1995 on the USA
Network & the SciFi Channel.
 
c|net Online will be a value-added service based on the World
Wide Web.  c|net Online will provide customized content &
powerful facilities for enabling the purchase of a wide range
of computer-related products.  c|net Online will provide
flxeible bulletin boards & online discussion groups.
 
c|net is headquartered in San Francisco.  But c|net Online will
be designed & built at the c|net Technology Office, which will
open during April in Central NJ.  The Technology Office will
also be responsible for the authoring/workflow system to be
used by the creative staff in San Francisco.
 
This is an unprecented opportunity to get in on the ground floor
of this exciting company.  We have immediate openings for top-notch
programmers & system designers.
 
All positions require:
   - excellent Unix programming skills (C/C++)
   - a degree in Computer Science (or related field)
   - networking (TCP/IP) & distributed systems experience
 
Salaries for all positions are negotiable & will depend on
qualifications.
 
--------------------------
PROGRAMMERS
 
Responsibilities: design, implementation, documentation & testing
of modules & systems.  Programming tasks will span a wide range,
from low-level systems work to high-level UI programming.
 
Educational requirements: BS in CS.
 
--------------------------
SYSTEM DESIGNERS
 
Responsibilities: determine requirements & design & architect
systems & subsystems. These will range from back-end server
subsystems to the authoring/workflow system.  System designers
must be hands-on & participate in programming.
 
Educational requirements: MS or PhD in CS (or BS with experience).
--------------------------
 
If interested, please send a resume & cover letter (email
preferred, FAX acceptable):
 
Jonathan Rosenberg
Executive Vice President, Technology
c|net inc.
